title: Revise raw county admissions to per-100k rate with 95% Poisson CI

reader_questions.question: Which county has the highest per-capita admission rate and what is it?
reader_questions.expected: Cedar-Flats at 154.8 per 100k residents (followed by Pine-Ridge at 138.8/100k).

reader_questions.question: How is count uncertainty represented for small rural counties?
reader_questions.expected: 95% Poisson confidence intervals showing wider bars for smaller populations.

reader_questions.question: How does the ranking change compared to the prior raw-count figure?
reader_questions.expected: Metro-North drops from #1 in raw counts to the lowest per-capita rate (44.8/100k).
